boss.skill.geometry: Gap fans / diamond gates / curved petals
dialogue.intro: Tuan: Auto-fire is on. You handle the fancy dodging.
dialogue.laser_ready: Tuan: Laser online! Even stars should duck!
dialogue.shield_ready: Tuan: Shields up! Three hits on the house.
dialogue.shield_empty: Tuan: Shield depleted. Back to fancy flying!
dialogue.hurt1: Tuan: Ouch! That was a very small target!
dialogue.hurt2: Tuan: Core hit! The hull is just decoration.
dialogue.hurt3: Tuan: Still flying! A little more finesse, please.
dialogue.laser_warning: Tuan: Red line charging. Clear that lane!
dialogue.laser_firing: Tuan: Laser firing! Stay outside the warning lane!
dialogue.final_waking: Tuan: All three elites down. The final core is waking.
dialogue.weapon_max: Tuan: Weapon maxed! Star Fangs are ready to bite!
dialogue.bone_energy: Tuan: Weapon maxed. Extra bones converted to energy!
dialogue.victory: Tuan: Four cores down. The universe is dark. We are not.
dialogue.defeat: Tuan: Keep the engine warm. We fly again.
dialogue.wave: Tuan: Wave {wave}, {formation} formation. A neat line of targets!
dialogue.shield_hit: Tuan: Hit blocked! {hits} shield charges left.
dialogue.elite_defeated: Tuan: Elite {elite} / 3 down! Next sector is open.
dialogue.weapon_level: Tuan: Weapon LV.{level}! Another pair of guns!
